dialogue.line: Welcome to HellCorp, Greg. We just acquired the police, the internet, and your soul.
dialogue.visual_prompt: Boss in a fiery office, wearing a suit and holding a pitchfork.

dialogue.line: Wait, my soul? I thought this was just a data entry job! I have a family! And a golden retriever! You can't just take my soul, it's not even in my contract!
dialogue.visual_prompt: Greg looking terrified, holding a stapler defensively.

dialogue.line: Oh, Greg. Section 4, paragraph 2. 'Employee surrenders all spiritual assets.' We've already monetized your dreams. They're being sold as NFTs to depressed crypto bros.
dialogue.visual_prompt: Boss holding a glowing red contract that is actively dripping lava.

dialogue.line: Plus, your golden retriever was reassigned to our fetching department. He's a middle manager now. He makes more than you.
dialogue.visual_prompt: HR Rep adjusting her cat-eye glasses, filing her nails with a miniature bone saw.

dialogue.line: This is a nightmare! I'm calling the police!
dialogue.visual_prompt: Greg frantically pulling out his cell phone.

dialogue.line: I literally just told you we acquired them. They are currently doing a team-building exercise in the magma chamber.
dialogue.visual_prompt: Boss sipping from a mug that says 'World's Best Demon'.

dialogue.line: Fine! Then I'll complain on the internet! I'll cancel you! I'll write a strongly worded review on Glassdoor!
dialogue.visual_prompt: Greg aggressively typing on his phone, veins popping on his forehead.

dialogue.line: Error. Glassdoor is now owned by HellCorp. Your review has been translated into agonizing pain.
dialogue.visual_prompt: A retro computer monitor nearby flashes red with an evil skull face.

dialogue.line: And we docked your pay for personal phone use during company hours. You now owe us three thousand dollars.
dialogue.visual_prompt: HR Rep typing on a clipboard that is literally on fire.

dialogue.line: I don't have three thousand dollars! I have crippling debt and a coupon for a half-off sandwich!
dialogue.visual_prompt: Greg holding up a sad, crinkled little sandwich coupon.

dialogue.line: We'll take the coupon. And your pancreas. It's company policy for underperforming assets.
dialogue.visual_prompt: Boss smiling evilly, revealing shark-like teeth.

dialogue.line: You monsters! You can't just harvest my organs! That's illegal in at least three dimensions!
dialogue.visual_prompt: Greg backing away, sweating profusely as shadows loom over him.

dialogue.line: Greg, please. We're not monsters. We're a family. A family that aggressively offboards you.
dialogue.visual_prompt: Boss putting a deceptively comforting hand on Greg's trembling shoulder.

dialogue.line: So, about that pancreas... should I get the bone saw or the melon baller?
dialogue.visual_prompt: HR Rep holding up a rusted bone saw in one hand and a shiny melon baller in the other.
